label: Stacked camera

manifest.name: Stacked camera
manifest.description: Guide and take long exposures with the same camera: the guider gets a frame every few seconds while the exposure builds up from the same frames.

title: Stacked camera
intro: Use one camera for guiding and imaging at once. The guider gets a short frame every few seconds, and long exposures are built from those same frames.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.none: Connect a camera in Equipment first.

settings.title: Short frames
settings.hint: An exposure is a whole number of short frames, so it is rounded up. Shorter frames guide faster; longer ones add less noise.
